nina: quick sync on a couple of RBAC UI things before code freeze: CSV export layout, bulk-invite error UX, and the SSO helper copy in invite modal. figma: https://www.figma.com/file/DEF/rbac-export-invite (frames: CSV_Export, BulkInvite_Errors, InviteSSO_Help) owen: CSV first: customers want ID + role + description + member count columns in that order. also include a header row with version and export timestamp. lina: agree on columns. UX Q: should descriptions be full text or truncated with ellipsis? for large orgs CSV size could explode. nina: include full text but add an export size warning when >1MB: "Export may be large; consider filtering by role." simple checkbox to confirm. sam-a11y: accessibility notes for export modal and bulk-invite: - export confirmation dialog must have focus trapped and return focus to the export button on close - progress should be announced with `role=\"status\" aria-live=\"polite\"` so screen-reader users know when file ready - bulk-invite errors: ensure row-level errors are in the DOM and linked with `aria-describedby` from the failing row lina: bulk-invite errors: we currently show toast + inline red row. customers asked for downloadable error CSV for failed rows. propose a link "Download failures (CSV)" when any failures occur. own: implementation note: server returns partial success with list of failed rows and reason. we'll add an endpoint `POST /orgs/:id/invite/bulk/errors` that returns CSV. nina: copy for that link: "Download failed invites" or "Export failed rows"? Product wants actionable phrase. sam-a11y: use "Download failed invites" - more explicit for screen readers. add `aria-label` on link: `Download failed invites as CSV` lina: invite modal SSO helper copy debate: product wants short label, design wants conversational helper. options: - Short control: "Require SSO" helper: "New invites must sign in using your org SSO. Existing members unaffected." - Conversational control: "Require SSO for invites" helper: "When on, anyone invited must complete SSO during signup; existing users remain unchanged." own: my vote for short control + slightly longer helper. also flag: when switching on, show inline checklist of "What to expect" since some orgs have mixed login flows. sam-a11y: aria suggestion for the helper tooltip: ensure it's reachable by keyboard and referenced by `aria-describedby` from the control. example: `` plus a hidden helper region `
New invites must sign in using your org SSO. Existing members unaffected.
` nina: great. Lina, can you add the helper copy to figma and show both short+long variants? add the export size warning mock too. lina: will do, uploading by EOD. PRs: Owen will add CSV meta header and error CSV endpoint; I'll add ARIA bits and helper copy. own: quick PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/web/pull/4472 - adds csv header and new error download endpoint. pm-bot: deploy-staging: rbac-export-bulkinvite branch deployed at 2025-02-14T11:02:09Z :rocket: sam-a11y: I'll run a smoke test on staging after PR merges: check focus return, aria-live announcements, link labels, downloadable failure CSV presence, NVDA + VoiceOver. nina: perfect. leaving this thread open until staging pass. tag me once tests pass. :thumbsup:
